# The rows of cdoc_jpha__text_and_number_comparison, one oracle row per line in the order of
# column D of the sheet text_and_number_comparison of crates/calc-func/tests/fixtures/cdoc_jpha/oracle.xlsx,
# which tests/fixtures/make-fixtures.ps1 writes from this file. Lines starting with # are comments.
#
# A text is written with printable ASCII as itself (except | and \) and any other UTF-16 code
# unit as \XXXX (four hex digits); \{N} repeats the code unit after it N times.
#
# t|op|left|right|expected   one row: left op right, two texts (written in the formula as text
#                            literals, with CHAR or UNICHAR for a character no literal holds)
# f|op|left|right|expected   one row: two number operands written as formula expressions
# N|left|right|eq|lt         four rows: =A=B, =A<B, =+A and =+B, with the numbers in A and B of
#                            the first row (the last two rows show the numbers Excel loaded)
# C|cell|text or n:number    a constant cell in column C or E
# c|op|cell|cell|expected    one row: two column-C cells compared
# COUNTIF|range|t:text or n:number|expected   one row
# L|function|key|array|more|expected   one row: function(key,array,more) with the key t:text or
#                            n:number (a literal, or two joined by +), the array a range of
#                            column E or {text} (an array constant of one text), and more the
#                            further arguments as the formula writes them (numbers, TRUE or
#                            FALSE, {7} and an empty one for an omitted argument), or none
#
# expected is Excel's raw value for the row's cell in the committed capture
# crates/calc-func/tests/captures/cdoc_jpha/oracle.capture.json: T, F, a number, #N/A, or s:text
# for a text. R marks a row calc_func refuses as not modelled, R0 or R1 one whose refusal names
# that argument (no row since dc-zsn.1 decided the text beyond cdoc-jpha's repertoire).
#
# 1. The kinds of cfunc-m1.2's 14 comparison rows (its sheet mixed_operands, D65, D71-D76, D82-D88).
